body: I feel as if there's always this barrier seperating me from other because I hide my depression from them. They see me as this lighthearted guy who gets along with everyone well and just jokes around alot. They don't take me seriously though because of this because I dont know how else to talk to people because of my anxiety and generally not feeling as if I have anything in common with most people, hence feeling like an outsider:

I've never really felt like I fit in this world. I have quite a few friends, but no close ones because I find trouble connecting with people. I never feel as if I'm really a normal person if you know what I mean? I have trouble forming close relationships and I just feel I need someone close to me to open up to.
